title: Generalized Killing spinors associated with the Ricci tensor
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notion of Ricci Killing spinors on Riemannian spin manifolds, which form a class between generalized Killing spinors and standard Killing spinors. We establish a rigidity result for Ricci Killing spinors and characterize simply connected Sasakian $η$-Einstein spin manifolds admitting Ricci Killing spinors. We also give a complete classification of Ricci Killing spinors on simply connected $3$-dimensional unimodular Lie groups with left-invariant Riemannian metrics.
